service.method: SELECT COMPANY_NAME_LOC AS COMPANY_NAME , COMPANY_CODE , IRS_NO FROM SCMGL WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%'

SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE, DEPT.COMPANY_CODE, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_JP, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_CN, CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC, DEPT.DEPT, DEPT.PARENT_DEPT, CASE '#session.LANGUAGE#' WHEN 'KO' THEN PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC WHEN 'JA' THEN PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_JP WHEN 'ZH' THEN PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_CN ELSE PDEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG END AS PARENT_DEPT_NAME FROM SDEPT DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SDEPT PDEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = PDEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = PDEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.PARENT_DEPT = PDEPT.DEPT LEFT OUTER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEPT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND (DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%' OR DEPT.PARENT_DEPT LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%' OR CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%' OR DEPT.DEPT LIKE '%' + UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) + '%')

SELECT DEPT.HOUSE_CODE, DEPT.COMPANY_CODE, CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC, DEPT.PLANT_CODE, DEPT.DEPT, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT.MANAGER_NAME, DEPT.MANAGER_POSITION, DEPT.PR_LOCATION, DEPT.PR_LOCATION_NAME, DEPT.CTRL_DEPT_FLAG, DEPT.PHONE_NO, DEPT.FAX_NO, DEPT.MENU_TYPE, DEPT.WORK_TYPE, DEPT.MENU_PROFILE_CODE, DEPT.SIGN_ATTACH_NO, DEPT.PARENT_DEPT, DEPT.MANAGER_ID, DEPT.DPC, DEPT.DPTSNA, DEPT.DPTCNA, DEPT.DPTCL, DEPT.DPTJL, DEPT.SAUP FROM SDEPT DEPT JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE WHERE DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT.DEPT = ${DEPT}

MERGE INTO SDEPT USING (SELECT '' A) DUAL ON ( HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT = ${DEPT} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DEPT_NAME_LOC = ${DEPT_NAME_LOC}, DEPT_NAME_ENG = ${DEPT_NAME_ENG}, DEPT_NAME_JP = ${DEPT_NAME_JP}, DEPT_NAME_CN = ${DEPT_NAME_CN}, DEPT = ${DEPT}, PARENT_DEPT = ${PARENT_DEPT} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, DEPT, DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT_NAME_JP, DEPT_NAME_CN, MANAGER_NAME, MANAGER_POSITION, PR_LOCATION, PR_LOCATION_NAME, CTRL_DEPT_FLAG, PHONE_NO, FAX_NO, MENU_TYPE, WORK_TYPE, MENU_PROFILE_CODE, SIGN_ATTACH_NO, PARENT_DEPT, MANAGER_ID, DPC, DPTSNA, DPTCNA, DPTCL, DPTJL, SAUP, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${DEPT}, ${DEPT_NAME_LOC}, ${DEPT_NAME_ENG}, ${DEPT_NAME_JP}, ${DEPT_NAME_CN}, ${MANAGER_NAME}, ${MANAGER_POSITION}, ${PR_LOCATION}, ${PR_LOCATION_NAME}, ${CTRL_DEPT_FLAG}, ${PHONE_NO}, ${FAX_NO}, ${MENU_TYPE}, ${WORK_TYPE}, ${MENU_PROFILE_CODE}, ${SIGN_ATTACH_NO}, ${PARENT_DEPT}, ${MANAGER_ID}, #{DPC}, ${DPTSNA}, ${DPTCNA}, #{DPTCL}, #{DPTJL}, ${SAUP}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID} );

SELECT MGL.LANGUAGE ,#DB_OWNER#GETCODETEXT2('M013',MGL.LANGUAGE,'#session.LANGUAGE#') LANGUAGE_NAME ,MGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC ,MGL.COMPANY_CODE ,MGL.COMPANY_NAME_ENG ,MGL.CUR ,MGL.COUNTRY ,MGL.CITY_CODE ,MGL.CITY_CODE CITY_CODE_NAME ,ADR.ADDRESS_LOC ADDRESS_LOC ,ADR.ADDRESS_ENG ADDRESS_ENG ,ADR.ZIP_CODE ZIP_CODE ,ADR.PHONE_NO1 PHONE_NO ,MGL.IRS_NO ,MGL.DUNS_NO ,ADR.HOMEPAGE HOMEPAGE ,MGL.FOUNDATION_DATE ,MGL.GROUP_COMPANY_CODE ,MGL.GROUP_COMPANY_NAME ,MGL.CREDIT_RATING ,MGL.INDUSTRY_TYPE ,MGL.INDUSTRY_TYPE INDUSTRY_TYPE_NAME ,ADR.CEO_NAME_LOC CEO_NAME ,MGL.BUSINESS_TYPE ,MGL.TRADE_AGENCY_NO ,MGL.TRADE_AGENCY_NAME ,MGL.EDI_ID ,MGL.EDI_QUALIFIER ,MGL.INS_COM_CODE ,MGL.ATTACH_NO FROM SCMGL MGL LEFT OUTER JOIN SADDR ADR ON MGL.HOUSE_CODE = ADR.HOUSE_CODE AND MGL.COMPANY_CODE = ADR.CODE_NO AND ADR.CODE_TYPE = 'COMPANY' WHERE 1=1 AND MGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND MGL.COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , CTRL_CODE , CTRL_TYPE , CTRL_NAME_LOC , CTRL_NAME_ENG FROM SBAGL BAGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = {session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE} AND ( 1 = 1 ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

WITH DATA AS( SELECT COMPANY_NAME_LOC TEXT ,HOUSE_CODE+'_'+COMPANY_CODE ID ,COMPANY_CODE CODE ,HOUSE_CODE PARENTID ,'COMPANY' TYPE FROM SCMGL WITH(NOLOCK) UNION ALL SELECT DEPT_NAME_LOC ,HOUSE_CODE+'_'+COMPANY_CODE+'_'+DEPT ,DEPT ,HOUSE_CODE+'_'+COMPANY_CODE ,'DEPT' FROM SDEPT WITH(NOLOCK)), LINKED AS( SELECT TEXT ,ID ,CODE ,PARENTID ,TYPE ,convert(varchar(255), right(N'00'+rtrim(CODE),10)) AS SORT FROM DATA WHERE CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND PARENTID = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} UNION ALL SELECT D.TEXT ,D.ID ,D.CODE ,D.PARENTID ,D.TYPE ,convert(varchar(255), convert(nvarchar,L.SORT) + '|' + right(N'00'+rtrim(D.CODE),10) ) AS SORT FROM DATA D JOIN LINKED L ON D.PARENTID = L.ID) SELECT TEXT ,ID ,CODE ,PARENTID ,TYPE FROM LINKED WHERE ( 1=1 AND TEXT LIKE '%'+ $S{F_KEYWORD} +'%' OR CODE LIKE '%'+ $S{F_KEYWORD} +'%' ) ORDER BY SORT

SELECT HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_TYPE, CTRL_NAME_LOC, CTRL_NAME_ENG, CTRL_NUMBER FROM SBAGL BAGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE IN ($INS{COMPANY_CODE}) AND ( 1=1 AND CTRL_CODE LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR CTRL_TYPE LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR CTRL_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR CTRL_NAME_ENG LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_TYPE, CTRL_NAME_LOC, CTRL_NAME_ENG FROM SBAGL BAGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND CTRL_NUMBER = ${CTRL_NUMBER}

INSERT INTO SBAGL ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_TYPE, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, DEL_FLAG, CTRL_NAME_LOC, CTRL_NAME_ENG, CTRL_NUMBER ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${CTRL_CODE}, ${CTRL_TYPE}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, 'N', ${CTRL_NAME_LOC}, ${CTRL_NAME_ENG}, ${CTRL_NUMBER} )

UPDATE SBAGL SET HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE}, CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE}, CTRL_TYPE = ${CTRL_TYPE}, CTRL_NAME_LOC = ${CTRL_NAME_LOC}, CTRL_NAME_ENG = ${CTRL_NAME_ENG}, CHANGE_DATE = ${current.date}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.time}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID} WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND CTRL_NUMBER = ${CTRL_NUMBER}

SELECT BALN.HOUSE_CODE, BALN.COMPANY_CODE, BALN.CTRL_CODE, BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID, USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS CTRL_PERSON_NAME, BAGL.CTRL_TYPE, BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC, BALN.REPRESENT_CTRL, BALN.APP_ORDER FROM SBALN BALN JOIN SBAGL BAGL ON BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND BAGL.CTRL_CODE = BALN.CTRL_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = USMT.USER_ID WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE IN ($INS{COMPANY_CODE}) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(BALN.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND (BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR USMT.USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%') AND BALN.CTRL_CODE = $S{CTRL_CODE}

SELECT HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_PERSON_ID, #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_PERSON_ID, '#session.LANGUAGE#') AS CTRL_PERSON_NAME, CTRL_TYPE, REPRESENT_CTRL, APP_ORDER FROM SBALN WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND CTRL_CODE = ${CTRL_CODE} AND CTRL_PERSON_ID = ${CTRL_PERSON_ID}

INSERT INTO SBALN ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, CTRL_CODE, CTRL_PERSON_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, DEL_FLAG, REPRESENT_CTRL, APP_ORDER ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${CTRL_CODE}, ${CTRL_PERSON_ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, 'N', ${REPRESENT_CTRL}, ${APP_ORDER} )
SELECT COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME_LOC FROM SCMGL WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}
SELECT DEPT , DEPT_NAME_LOC FROM S0015 WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}

INSERT INTO SDEPT ( HOUSE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, DEPT, DEPT_NAME_LOC, DEPT_NAME_ENG, DEPT_NAME_JP, DEPT_NAME_CN, MANAGER_NAME, MANAGER_POSITION, PR_LOCATION, PR_LOCATION_NAME, CTRL_DEPT_FLAG, PHONE_NO, FAX_NO, MENU_TYPE, WORK_TYPE, MENU_PROFILE_CODE, SIGN_ATTACH_NO, PARENT_DEPT, MANAGER_ID, DPC, DPTSNA, DPTCNA, DPTCL, DPTJL, SAUP, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE}, ${DEPT}, ${DEPT_NAME_LOC}, ${DEPT_NAME_ENG}, ${DEPT_NAME_JP}, ${DEPT_NAME_CN}, ${MANAGER_NAME}, ${MANAGER_POSITION}, ${PR_LOCATION}, ${PR_LOCATION_NAME}, ${CTRL_DEPT_FLAG}, ${PHONE_NO}, ${FAX_NO}, ${MENU_TYPE}, ${WORK_TYPE}, ${MENU_PROFILE_CODE}, ${SIGN_ATTACH_NO}, ${PARENT_DEPT}, ${MANAGER_ID}, #{DPC}, ${DPTSNA}, ${DPTCNA}, #{DPTCL}, #{DPTJL}, ${SAUP}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID}, ${current.date}, ${current.time}, ${session.ID} )

SELECT CODE AS POSITION, TEXT1 AS POSITION_NAME, SORT_SEQ FROM SCODE WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE ='UX049' AND DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND ( 1=1 AND TEXT1 LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' OR CODE LIKE '%' + $S{F_KEYWORD} + '%' ) AND ( 1=1 AND CODE = $S{POSITION} ) ORDER BY SORT_SEQ ASC

UPDATE SCODE SET HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, CHANGE_DATE = ${current.DATE}, CHANGE_TIME = ${current.TIME}, CHANGE_USER_ID = ${session.ID}, TEXT1 = ${POSITION_NAME}, SORT_SEQ = #{SORT_SEQ} WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND TYPE = 'UX049' AND CODE = ${POSITION}
